text:
The dish is a square plate of about 24 cm, holding roughly 12 to 14 roasted sweet potato cubes. Most cubes are about 3 cm across, and a few pieces are smaller.

A 3 cm cube of sweet potato weighs about 25 g. Thirteen pieces at that size come to roughly 300 g, but many look smaller and some are only partial cubes, so I estimate about 200 g in total.

Roasted sweet potato is about 1.1 kcal/g, or about 1.3 kcal/g with some oil. That gives about 200 × 1.2 ≈ 240 kcal.

{"kcal": 240, "mass_g": 200}
